description:
## Problem
BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#242 (branch `docs/run-timeout-error-import`, base `next`) updates the site for BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4446: `from benchbox.core.exceptions import RunTimeoutError` in `docs/usage/data-generation.md` and the run-time-limit row of `docs/reference/public-contracts.md`; `ExecutionConfigHelper.optimize_for_system(cpu_cores)` without `memory_gb` and without memory-based timeouts in `docs/reference/python-api/utilities.md`, `docs/usage/configuration.md`, `docs/usage/examples.md` and `docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md`; and `timeout_minutes=120` dropped from the built-in execution defaults. It cannot merge: its required job `lint, types, unit tests and build` fails at the step "Check the site documentation against the docs inputs' contracts" with the same three TPC-DI violations that fail `next` itself (CI on `next` at 7e90968): the benchmark API snapshot marker in `reference/public-contracts.md`, and `benchmarks/support-status.md` saying TPC-DI is beta with 38 queries while the contracts give `document_only` and 0. The repository does not allow auto-merge, so the merge needs a person or agent to act once `next` is green.

## Change
Once `next` passes CI, update #242 with `next` (merge, no force-push), re-run its checks, and merge it with squash. Make no other content change unless the merged BenchBox code changed again; if it did, re-check each sentence against `benchbox/core/exceptions.py`, `benchbox/utils/run_deadline.py` and `benchbox/utils/config_helpers.py` on develop.

## Decision gates
- Do not fix the TPC-DI contract violations in this pull request; they belong to tpcdi-site-release-pin-contract-20261121 and its owner decisions (registry status `document_only`, notice stays until the new pages land).
- If `next` stays red for a reason other than those three violations, stop and report it on this item; do not merge around a failed required check.

## Verification rubric
Pass: #242 merged into `next`; its CI green on the merged head; `npm run lint:docs`, `npm run test:docs-contracts` and `npm run docs:check` pass in a worktree of `next` after the merge; `git grep -n "run_deadline import RunTimeoutError\|memory_gb" -- docs` on `next` finds no reference to the old import path or to the removed argument (adapter `timeout_minutes` parameters and `benchmarks.timeout_minutes` are different settings and stay).
Fail: any of these not met.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
This is the benchbox-site repository: work in a linked worktree of it, never in `/Users/joe/Developer/benchbox-site` itself.
